title: gymnadenia conopsea subsp. pyrenaica
intro: Gymnadenia conopsea subsp. pyrenaica, commonly known as Pyrenean fragrant orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Gymnadenia conopsea subsp. pyrenaica include its ability to act as a natural expectorant, anti-inflammatory agent, and antioxidant, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
